ops.given: Start a fresh store holding these workspaces. Answers null.
ops.workspaces: The workspaces kept: `[{ id, name, kind, createdAt }]`.
ops.createWorkspace: (workspace, snapshot) Keep a new workspace and all its records. Answers null.
ops.load: (workspaceId, window?) The workspace’s records. With `window` (`{ from }`): only the check-ins of cycles whose last day is on or after `from`’s day, and only the change-log entries from `from` on plus the anchors of any age (comments, asks, a cycle’s entries, an import’s summary or undoing, or any entry carrying `undo`), and `history: { from, checkInCycles }` (every cycle with a check-in, sorted); without one, everything, and no `history`.
ops.commit: (workspaceId, commit) Save it whole or not at all: a saved goal or review is one version on; refuse it as stale when a goal or review it `expect`s has moved on. Never changes another workspace’s records. Answers null.
ops.issueToken: (workspaceId, commit) Keep the commit’s new AI assistant token and answer its secret (at least 20 characters, no spaces), which is never kept or given back.
ops.deleteWorkspace: (workspaceId) Remove the workspace and everything in it. Answers null.
ops.history: (workspaceId, { before?, goalId?, size? }) Change-log entries a page at a time, newest first (by `at`, then `id`, both descending): `{ changes, next }`, those strictly older than `before` (`{ at, id }`), only one goal’s when `goalId` is given, 50 unless `size` says otherwise and never more than 100; `next` is the last entry’s `{ at, id }` when there are more, else null.
